set_source_files_properties(${TAU_IMPORTED_FILES} PROPERTIES HEADER_FILE_ONLY TRUE)

add_library(
	tau_legacy STATIC
		compat/tau_harfang_runtime.cpp
		compat/tau_placeholder.cpp
		${TAU_IMPORTED_FILES}
)
target_include_directories(tau_legacy
	PUBLIC
		$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/harfang>
		$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/source>
		$<BUILD_INTERFACE:${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/compat>
)
set_target_properties(tau_legacy PROPERTIES FOLDER "harfang/3rdparty/tau")
